title: Noniv/abyssal-garden
why_read: A visually impressive, self-contained WebGPU demo generating an underwater scene entirely procedurally in a single small HTML file, interesting for graphics programmers.
analysis: This project renders a swimmable underwater environment—kelp, sunbeams, a shipwreck, manta rays—entirely through procedural code using WebGPU, with no external image, model, or sound assets. Fitting this into a 97 KB single HTML file is a notable feat of procedural generation and shader programming, similar in spirit to classic demoscene work. It's primarily a technical showcase of WebGPU capabilities and procedural graphics techniques rather than a tool with practical application. Graphics and shader programmers will likely find it inspiring and worth studying for technique, even though it has no broader utility.
